item.title: 🔴 TP-Link patches Omada ZTP flaws allowing hackers to breach networks
item.description:
Why this matters: Potential data exposure — check monitoring and incident response readiness.
TP-Link has patched 15 vulnerabilities in the zero-touch provisioning (ZTP) mechanism of its Omada network devices that could be chained with previously disclosed flaws to achieve remote code execution (RCE). [...]

item.title: 🔴 When Vibe Hacking Turns AI into the Junior Hacker Every Adversary Always Wanted
item.description:
